technical.summary: Strong uptrend structure with all moving averages bullish and price at new highs, but extreme overbought RSI/Stoch readings and lack of fresh crossover confirmation limit swing entry probability; better suited for pullback entry or profit-taking.

fundamental.summary: MPC shows no fundamental momentum with zero insider activity, no institutional signal, absent government contracts, no lobbying presence, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 15 days present material risk with no supporting smart money conviction.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (28/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absent congressional conviction and stale trading data (605+ days old) limit conviction.

risk.summary: Crisis VIX (404.96), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and earnings in 15 days create a highly adverse macro backdrop for MPC.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme overbought RSI/Stoch with price at 52-week highs and all major moving averages bullish creates a contrarian fear-zone opportunity in a structurally uptrending market.
debate.key_bear_argument: Crisis-level VIX, earnings risk within 15 days, zero fundamental/insider conviction, unfavorable macro (rising dollar, flat yield curve), and extreme overbought conditions without fresh crossover confirmation make this a high-risk entry with elevated pullback probability.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure is bullish with price above all major moving averages, but extreme overbought conditions (RSI 77, Stoch 93) without fresh crossover confirmation create poor risk/reward for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 15 days combined with crisis-level VIX and zero fundamental conviction creates material gap risk; extreme overbought technicals invite pullback before any further upside.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on elevated risk and weak conviction
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding MPC position with 20 other Energy positions in portfolio; adding here increases sector concentration risk without offsetting fundamental or smart money support.
